system.name: DSV
system.one_liner: a system that accelerates video DiT training via dynamic query/key low-rank sparsity and sparsity-aware context parallelism

components.name: Latent noised video input (FxHxWxC)
components.role: the noised latent video tensor fed into the DiT model

components.name: Token Embedding
components.role: embeds the latent noised video into tokens for the DiT blocks

components.name: Conditioning
components.role: conditioning signals combined with the video tokens

components.name: Time stamp
components.role: diffusion timestep used as a conditioning signal

components.name: Text Prompt
components.role: text prompt used as conditioning and as the key-value input to the cross-attention module

components.name: DiT Block
components.role: processes video tokens alongside conditioning through self-attention and cross-attention, repeated N times

components.name: Post Process and Reshape
components.role: reshapes the DiT blocks' output into the predicted noise/flow

components.name: Training Loss
components.role: computed from the predicted noise/flow versus the input noise/flow

components.name: Spatial Attention
components.role: self-attention restricted to the spatial dimensions of video tokens

components.name: Temporal Attention
components.role: self-attention restricted to the temporal dimension of video tokens

components.name: Full Attention
components.role: 3D self-attention over all video tokens jointly instead of factorized spatial/temporal attention

components.name: Cross Attention
components.role: aligns video tokens with text-prompt embeddings, used in both attention variants

flows.what: video tokens plus conditioning (timestamp, text prompt)
processed tokens after N DiT blocks
predicted noise/flow compared against input noise/flow

content.key_idea: A video DiT model embeds noised latent video tokens, conditions them on timestamp and text prompt, and repeatedly applies DiT blocks whose self-attention is either factorized spatial/temporal attention or full 3D attention, each followed by cross-attention to the text prompt.
content.reading_order: Left to right in (a): input video latent through token embedding and N DiT blocks to the training loss; (b) and (c) on the right detail two alternative attention arrangements inside a block.

evidence: the DiT model consists of multiple DiT blocks that process video tokens alongside conditional inputs
self-attention modules, which employ interleaved spatial and temporal attention or full attention
cross attention aligns the video with text prompts, ensuring consistency between modalities

summary: This figure illustrates the standard video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) training pipeline that motivates DSV. Panel (a) shows a latent noised video input (FxHxWxC) passing through token embedding, combined with conditioning from a diffusion timestep and a text prompt, into a stack of N DiT blocks; the output is post-processed and reshaped into a predicted noise/flow, whose difference from the input noise/flow forms the training loss. Panels (b) and (c) zoom into the self-attention design inside each DiT block: (b) interleaves Temporal Attention and Spatial Attention, each paired with Cross Attention to the text-prompt embeddings; (c) instead uses two rounds of 3D Full Attention, likewise paired with Cross Attention. The diagram uses flat light-blue boxes for shared modules and a distinct lavender box to set Spatial Attention apart, on a white background with square corners and thin solid connectors.
summary_zh: 该图展示视频 DiT 训练的标准流程：噪声视频隐变量经 Token 嵌入与时间步/文本提示条件化后，输入 N 个 DiT Block，再经后处理得到预测噪声并计算训练损失；(b)(c) 分别展示时空分离注意力与全注意力两种设计，均搭配交叉注意力对齐文本提示。
notes: system fields describe DSV, the paper's overall contribution, though this specific figure (in the Background section) depicts the generic/baseline video DiT architecture that DSV's sparsity techniques are later applied to, not a DSV-novel component.
